name: @landingos/product-registry
description: The product-module contract. Lets the platform mount any number of products without knowing which exist.
//no-build-step: Authored in TypeScript and published as TypeScript. Node 24 strips types natively so `node --test` runs the suite directly, and Next transpiles workspace packages, so both consumers read the source. A build step here would buy nothing and add a stale-dist failure mode.
